sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Chisone (SUP-C) has conditional qualification as of the last board record. No newer document lifts it. Moving BR-310 deliveries to a new receiving plant is new business for a conditional supplier.

sources.quote: roof rail bracket for the Nordhavn Fjell (PRG-Y)

findings.why: The part card names Chisone as source for BR-310 (Nordhavn). No controlled record gives a source approval per receiving plant, so nothing shows whether Chisone is approved for BR-310 to Beinasco (PLT-BEI). Pinerolo is the current plant by the proposal's wording, and Beinasco is the new one. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm.

findings.key: 8D cracking on Chisone 6082 material (no issue id in documents)

sources.quote: the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open

findings.why: BR-310 is made from EN AW-6082-T5, and Chisone has an open cracking 8D on its 6082 material. No document shows it as closed. The issue id is not given in the documents.
